newsitem.title: UK: SWIMMING-SMITH FAILS IN WORLD RECORD BID.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-SMITH FAILS IN WORLD RECORD BID.

text.p: Ireland's triple Olympic gold medallist Michelle Smith failed by over two seconds in a world record bid in the 200 metres butterfly at the Irish Open Championships on Friday.

She said she was disappointed with her performance and would decide next week whether to defend her 200 metres butterfly and 200 metres individual medley titles at the European championships in August.
Smith won in two minutes 8.15 seconds, well outside the 16-year-old world mark of 2:05.96 held by American Mary T. Meagher.
"Maybe I'm not as fit as I thought, but I wouldn't have gone for that record if I didn't think I could break it," she said.
